localDoulas.name: Rebecca Turrigiano
localDoulas.description: Rebecca Turrigiano has attended births for 13 years, and her DoulaMatch profile carries verified certification along with more than 210 client testimonials. Birth packages run $2,200 to $3,900. That places her at the experienced end of West Valley pricing. She works with families delivering at Banner Thunderbird and across the Phoenix metro. Her profile lists evidence-based labor coping, birth-plan preparation, and partner coaching among her strengths. Tenure like that is uncommon in doula work. Her client feedback reads steady.

localDoulas.name: Kay Clinton
localDoulas.description: Kay Clinton is a Glendale-based birth and postpartum doula with 6 years in practice through Spiritual Garden Healing Doula Services. Birth packages run $1,500 to $3,500. Postpartum support is $50 to $100 per hour. That makes her one of the more affordable overnight-help options in the West Valley. Her listing emphasizes continuous labor presence, newborn care after you are home, and a calm, spiritual approach to birth support. For a family stretching its budget, that hourly postpartum rate deserves a close look.

localDoulas.name: Mother and Earth Doula Services
localDoulas.description: Mother and Earth Doula Services is a service-area practice based in Glendale and available around the clock at (623) 451-8034, holding a 5-star rating across 4 Google reviews. Families repeatedly name lead doula Deidra in their reviews. She taught one couple birthing class with so much useful information. She stayed through a hospital delivery until everything settled down. Reviews give her a strong but calm presence in the delivery room, and support covers prenatal education, labor and birth, and postpartum follow-up.

localDoulas.name: The Golden Doula Services
localDoulas.description: The Golden Doula Services answers 24/7 at (623) 231-1196 with a 4.5-star Google rating. Client reviews name doula Monique. She supported an unmedicated hospital birth where the mother later wrote that the tips for a smooth labor were a godsend. The same review says she had the birth she wanted without any intervention or medication. Monique is also praised for educating partners during pregnancy, which makes this practice a good fit for couples who want to feel prepared together.

localDoulas.name: Jada I. Rush
localDoulas.description: Jada I. Rush is a Licensed Midwife in the State of Arizona, and nationally she holds the Certified Professional Midwife credential. She owns Rah Midwifery, a West Valley home birth practice, and also holds LMFT and PMH-C credentials. Her prenatal and postpartum care carries an unusually strong perinatal mental-health foundation. Rah Midwifery covers Glendale, Avondale, Tolleson, Goodyear, South Peoria, Litchfield Park, El Mirage, Verrado, Surprise, and West/Northwest Phoenix. Free home-birth consultations are offered, and most families start there before they commit to the full package.
